note: Held-out traffic task prompts for the shop (PLAN 5.9), written by the TRAFFIC builder without reading any contract. Only the tool-call arguments the agents send are kept (oracle criterion 5, stratum S-agent); the prompts are not graded. They ask for things a shopper would ask on the original catalog, through all four tools.
